item.title: FDA approves Helix Therapeutics' lung cancer drug Velorin, shares surge
item.description: Helix Therapeutics (HLXT) won FDA approval for Velorin, its first commercial product, beating analyst expectations on timing.

item.title: Apex Cloud is reportedly in talks to be acquired by a private equity group, people familiar say
item.description: Apex Cloud (APXC) is exploring a sale; no deal is certain, according to people familiar with the matter.
